ai_show_review.summary: Scorching early‑psychedelic set with stellar Cardboard Cowboy & Cream Puff War
ai_show_review.blurb: The July 29, 1966 Vancouver show delivers high‑energy renditions of Cardboard Cowboy, Viola Lee Blues and an inspired Cream Puff War. Jerry’s guitar tone shines on Baby Blue and Next Time You See Me, while Pigpen’s organ drives the early psychedelic vibe.
ai_show_review.review: On July 29, 1966 at the P.N.E. Garden Auditorium in Vancouver, the Dead were locked into a raw, high‑octane groove that captures the band’s early psychedelic spirit. The set rolls through an unrelenting stream of blues‑rock and folk‑psychedelia – from the rollicking “Standing On The Corner” to the haunting “It’s All Over Now Baby Blue,” culminating in a blistering “Cream Puff War.” Reviewers rave about Jerry Garcia’s soaring, razor‑sharp guitar on “Baby Blue” and “Next Time You See Me,” and his early brilliance shines especially on the “Cream Puff War” solo. Phil Lesh adds tight, high‑part harmonies on “Viola Lee Blues,” while Pigpen’s organ punches through on “Stealin’,” “Cardboard Cowboy” and “Cream Puff War.” The soundboard capture is remarkably clear for a 1966 tape, with crisp organ and guitars that let every nuance of the band’s improvisational fire be heard. Overall this performance stands out as one of the most vivid snapshots of the Dead’s formative era.

best_recording.reason: Excellent soundboard capture with crisp organ and Jerry’s soaring guitar; highest audio clarity among the available sources.

key_highlights: Cardboard Cowboy delivers a scorching, organ‑driven groove.
Viola Lee Blues showcases tight vocal harmonies and extended jams.
Cream Puff War features early Garcia brilliance and powerful soloing.
It’s All Over Now Baby Blue highlights Pigpen’s gritty organ work.

band_performance.Jerry: Ripping, soaring guitar tone on “Next Time You See Me,” “Baby Blue,” and a standout solo in “Cream Puff War.”
band_performance.Phil: Provides high‑part vocal harmonies on “Viola Lee Blues,” anchoring the early psychedelic sound.
band_performance.Bob: Low in the mix but still audible, contributing rhythm guitar without detracting from the overall flow.
